meta.river_mile_datum: NYS DEC Hudson River miles, The Battery = 0. Cornwall-on-Hudson is river mile ~56 and has no public sensor; the West Point sonde (about river mile 52) is the nearest live water-quality station. Labeled miles follow the DEC/Cary Hudson River mile map (Piermont 25, Haverstraw 35, Peekskill 45, Newburgh 60, Poughkeepsie 75, Staatsburg 85, Tivoli 100, Coxsackie 125, Albany 145). Unlabeled sites are interpolated on that scale.
meta.focus: Main-stem Hudson from Tappan Zee / Piermont (south) through Poughkeepsie (north).

hrecos.note: HRECOS left USGS NWIS in 2026. Current values are the NYS Mesonet CSV API, not waterservices.usgs.gov. USGS pages for these sites point at https://hrecos.org/live-data/.

not_stations.name: New Rochelle
not_stations.note: NOAA 8518490 is New Rochelle on Long Island Sound, not Newburgh. The static site label is wrong. Newburgh tide predictions are 8518935.

not_stations.name: Cornwall-on-Hudson
not_stations.note: No public real-time station at the village (river mile ~56).

not_stations.name: Marlboro
not_stations.note: No public real-time station. NOAA has no Marlboro ID.

not_stations.name: Croton-on-Hudson
not_stations.note: No public real-time main-stem station. Nearby USGS sites are tributary gages (Croton and tributaries), not the Hudson.

not_stations.name: USGS Hudson River at South Dock at West Point
not_stations.note: Last real instantaneous values 2014-09-11. Replaced by HRECOS HWEST at the same dock.

not_stations.name: USGS Hudson River at Piermont
not_stations.note: Instantaneous values are the discontinued sentinel -999999 (April 2026). Replaced by HRECOS HPMNT.

not_stations.name: USGS Hudson River near Poughkeepsie
not_stations.note: USGS directs users to hrecos.org for data after 2026-03-31. Replaced by HRECOS HPOUG.

not_stations.name: USGS Hudson River below Poughkeepsie
not_stations.note: Last instantaneous water temperature 2019-11-06. Not a live station.

not_stations.name: USGS Hudson River near Schodack Landing
not_stations.note: All instantaneous values are -999999 since 2026-04-29. The colocated HRECOS site HSCHO also has no sensor values.

not_stations.name: Bear Mountain, Hudson River Reserve
not_stations.note: NDBC activestations lists hbmn6, but https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/data/realtime2/HBMN6.txt returns HTTP 404. NERRS CDMO station hudbmwq (the SWMP sonde at Iona Island / Bear Mountain, river mile 45) rejects unregistered client IPs, so there is no anonymous live feed.

stations.name: Piermont
stations.note: HRECOS sonde at Piermont Pier, south end of Tappan Zee. Dissolved oxygen is reported as percent saturation only; concentration is empty. USGS 01376269 is not current.

stations.name: Tarrytown
stations.note: NOAA subordinate tide station at Tappan Zee (reference The Battery 8518750). No water-level sensor and no water-quality feed.

stations.name: Haverstraw
stations.note: NOAA harmonic tide predictions only. No observed water level or water quality.

stations.name: Peekskill
stations.note: NOAA subordinate tide station (reference The Battery 8518750). Direct predictions requests return no data; apply tidepredoffsets to the reference station.

stations.name: Bear Mountain
stations.note: HRNERR SWMP sonde near Iona Island (CDMO hudbmwq, about river mile 45). NDBC realtime2/HBMN6.txt is HTTP 404 and CDMO web services reject anonymous IPs, so this station is not a public live endpoint.

stations.name: West Point
stations.note: HRECOS sonde at South Dock, the live water-quality station for the West Point / Cornwall-on-Hudson reach (Cornwall village is about river mile 56 and has no sensor). USGS 01374019 ended in 2014.

stations.name: Newburgh
stations.note: Primary tide station for Cornwall-on-Hudson, about 3 miles downstream. Subordinate to The Battery 8518750 (time offsets about +226/+243 minutes, height ratio 0.62). No observed water level, temperature, or water quality. Not NOAA 8518490.

stations.name: Beacon
stations.note: NOAA harmonic tide predictions (Beacon, Flushkill). No water-temperature or water-quality sensor. Fallback when Newburgh subordinate predictions are unavailable.

stations.name: New Hamburg
stations.note: NOAA subordinate tide station between Beacon and Poughkeepsie. Predictions only.

stations.name: Poughkeepsie
stations.note: HRECOS sonde at Poughkeepsie, north end of the focus reach. USGS 01372043 is not the current feed.

stations.name: Poughkeepsie tide
stations.note: NOAA subordinate tide predictions. Observed water level is not published here; water quality is HRECOS HPOUG.

stations.name: Norrie Point
stations.note: HRNERR meteorological station upstream of Poughkeepsie. Water temperature and gusts are missing (MM) in the realtime file. Water-quality buoy NPQN6 has no realtime2 file.

stations.name: Turkey Point
stations.note: NOAA CO-OPS / Hudson River NERRS PORTS station upstream of Poughkeepsie. Same physical station as NDBC TKPN6; CO-OPS is the feed used here because it includes water level and conductivity.

stations.name: Coxsackie
stations.note: NOAA CO-OPS station well upstream of the focus reach. Same physical station as NDBC CXHN6; CO-OPS is the feed used here.

stations.name: Schodack Landing
stations.note: Out of focus. Kept because older builds polled it. HRECOS HSCHO currently publishes coordinates only, and USGS 0135980207 instantaneous values are -999999 since 2026-04-29.

stations.name: Port of Albany
stations.note: Out of focus. Live HRECOS water-quality station at the Port of Albany, about 3 km south of USGS 01359139.

stations.name: Albany
stations.note: Out of focus. USGS NWIS instantaneous water temperature is still updating. Not the same instrument as HRECOS HPORT.
